description: This file defines the class SugarWidgetSubPanelTopCreateLeadNameButton, a custom widget for the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM platform that provides a button for creating new Lead records from subpanels, with context-specific prefilled data based on the focus module.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelTopCreateLeadNameButton
